_comment: Backlog for the weekly harness-build routine (.claude/skills/harness-build). Order = priority. The routine picks the first entry with status 'planned', researches the host's current hook/plugin API from official docs, builds the integration and opens a draft PR. It updates this file in that PR. Statuses: planned, in_progress, pr_open, merged, blocked. Scope agreed with the maintainer: only Cursor, GitHub Copilot and optionally Antigravity. When no entry is 'planned' or 'in_progress', the routine reports that and opens no PR.

harnesses.name: Cursor (IDE agent and cursor-agent CLI)
harnesses.notes: Highest priority. Check the hooks system (shell, MCP, file read/edit events) and whether the headless cursor-agent CLI runs the same hooks so a real-binary test is possible.

harnesses.name: GitHub Copilot (CLI and coding agent)
harnesses.notes: Second priority. Cover the Copilot CLI first if it exposes hooks; document what the cloud coding agent allows.

harnesses.name: Google Antigravity
harnesses.notes: Optional third host. Only build it after Cursor and Copilot are merged or blocked.
